about: Focused scheduler regression mutants, run with their named killers. Model searches reserve all scheduler slots for memory isolation.

mutants.name: b15-r8-run-memory-reservation-disconnected
mutants.rule: The running gate connects MemoryHeavy to an exclusive slot reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-model-memory-unreserved
mutants.rule: Every model search declares a full-gate memory reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-slot-undercharged
mutants.rule: A queued memory-heavy step reserves all requested slots, not one.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-immediate-undercharged
mutants.rule: An immediate memory-heavy reservation also takes all requested slots.

mutants.name: gateex-examples-step-uncounted
mutants.rule: The fast-tier CPU budget counts the examples step.

mutants.name: gateex-step-recorded-as-package
mutants.rule: -record-durations -fast records a budgeted step under its step name.

mutants.name: tc-gate-managed-go
mutants.rule: A gate step's ergo builds with the go of go.mod's toolchain and never downloads Go, unless the caller sets ERGO_GO.

mutants.name: b18-full-tier-package-unrecognized
mutants.rule: A package whose every test builds Go (each Test function starts with needsBuild) has no fast-tier step, so a checker edit does not compile, link and start its test binary to skip every test.

mutants.name: b18-full-tier-package-stepped
mutants.rule: The fast tier declares no step for a full-tier-only package (fullTierOnly).

mutants.name: b17-fast-all-large-stepped
mutants.rule: A package whose every test is large has no fast step, so it costs the fast budget nothing.

mutants.name: gf3-shards-dealt-by-wall
mutants.rule: A package with recorded CPU rows deals its shards by CPU, not wall time.

mutants.name: gf3-hang-floor-at-go-default
mutants.rule: No go test step's deadline is go test's 15 minute default.

mutants.name: gf3-build-step-without-deadline
mutants.rule: Every go test command of a step passes -timeout.

mutants.name: gf3-shard-deadline-ignores-cost
mutants.rule: A shard's deadline is ten times its recorded cost.

mutants.name: gf3-pause-keeps-the-span
mutants.rule: A paused test's wait is not its CPU.

mutants.name: gate-key-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 (batch-18 verify, gate start key)
mutants.from: entries = slices.DeleteFunc(entries, func(e replay.Entry) bool { return gateOutput(e.Path, e.Class) })
mutants.rule: No key holds the gate's own outputs (bin/): a gate started on a stale bin/ergo, which its build rewrites, still records.

mutants.name: gate-replay-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (orchestrator: a replay leaves a stale bin/ergo)
mutants.rule: After a whole-gate replay the gate builds its outputs again, so bin/ergo matches the tree.

mutants.name: gate-prescope-replay-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (orchestrator: a replay leaves a stale bin/ergo)
mutants.rule: The replay before the scope builds bin/ergo again, so the binary matches the tree.

mutants.name: sandbox-first-process-unwatched
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (no fixed run limits in scripts/gate)

mutants.rule: A sandbox whose first process fails is a failure at once: with no time bound on the start, the watch of that process is what ends the wait (killed by the test's deadline, which names TestMergeTierFailsClosed/bwrap_fails_to_mount).

mutants.name: gs3-fast-runs-all
mutants.rule: The fast tier's examples step runs only the programs of scripts/examples/fast-tier.txt; the full tier runs every default program.

mutants.name: gs4-coverage-ignored
mutants.rule: A function body's edit runs the tests whose recorded blocks it touches.

mutants.name: gs4-reads-ignored
mutants.to: moved[i] = false && readState(root, r.Path, r.Lookup) != r.State
mutants.rule: A file, directory or lookup a test read that is now otherwise runs that test.

mutants.name: gs4-env-ignored
mutants.rule: A variable a test read whose value changed runs that test.

mutants.name: gs9-observed-embed-runs-all
mutants.from: // An observed embedded file: its readers (below).
mutants.rule: An edit of an observed embedded file (a std .ergo file) reruns its readers, not every test.

mutants.name: gs9-record-unobserved
mutants.rule: The record sets the observe variable, so a test's reads of observed embedded files are in its record.

mutants.name: gs11-cli-unrecorded
mutants.rule: The record hands a test of a recordedCLIs package the covered CLI: a test that runs the command is not tied to every source file by a build of its own.

mutants.name: gs11-cli-counters-lost
mutants.from: script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nGOCOVERDIR='%s' %s='%s' exec '%s' \"$@\"\n", counters, embedObserveVariable, root, cli)
mutants.to: script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\n%s='%s' exec '%s' \"$@\"\n", embedObserveVariable, root, cli)
mutants.rule: The CLI a test runs writes its counters beside the test's, whatever environment the test gives it: a body the command runs selects the test.

mutants.name: gs11-cli-embeds-unobserved
mutants.from: script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nGOCOVERDIR='%s' %s='%s' exec '%s' \"$@\"\n", counters, embedObserveVariable, root, cli)
mutants.rule: The CLI a test runs observes its embedded files whatever environment the test gives it: an edit of an embedded std file the CLI reads selects the test.
mutants.gap: The fixtures run plain go tests, which observe only their own process (a child is observed under internal/testinputs.Main, which a module outside this one cannot import), so no fixture sees the CLI open its embedded file. Receipt: the cmd/ergo record lists the tests that read internal/sketch/std/json/fields.ergo (gs11 request).

mutants.name: gs9-embed-own-folder
mutants.rule: An embedded file in a folder below its package (std's json/*.ergo) belongs to that package: it is observed, so its edit reruns its readers only.

mutants.name: gs9-prefix-observes
mutants.to: slices.ContainsFunc(observedEmbeds, func(d string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(rel, d+"/") })
mutants.rule: A file another package embeds below an observing package (std's gostd/src) is not observed: its edit runs every test.

mutants.name: gs10-shared-gotmpdir
mutants.rule: The record runs each test with its own GOTMPDIR, so the shared one's listing, which every go build changes, is no read that selects a test.

mutants.name: gs4-declaration-as-body
mutants.rule: An edit outside every function body (a constant, a declaration) runs every test: no block holds it.

mutants.name: gs4-one-hunk

mutants.rule: Two edited function bodies of one file are two hunks, each judged in its function (the line diff), not one span across both.

mutants.name: gs4-skip-unwired
mutants.rule: A test the selection skips joins the names every shard of the package skips.

mutants.name: gs6-chain-ignored
mutants.rule: A step's priority adds the longest chain of the steps that need it.

mutants.name: gs6-times-ignored
mutants.rule: A step's recorded time on this host replaces its declared weight.

mutants.name: gs6-last-not-longest
mutants.rule: The longest of a step's kept times weighs it, not the last, so a run that replayed most of the step does not start it last next time.

mutants.name: gs6-run-ignores-priority
mutants.rule: The gate's slots go by stepPriorities, not the declared weight alone.

mutants.name: gs6-times-unwritten
mutants.from: if err := writeStepTimes(g.cacheDir, times, g.steps, results); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := writeStepTimes("", times, g.steps, results); err != nil {
mutants.rule: A run records its steps' times in the gate cache for the next run.

mutants.name: gs6-keep-all
mutants.rule: The times file keeps each step's last stepTimesKept times: it does not grow with every run.

mutants.name: gs6-failed-recorded
mutants.rule: A failed step's time, cut short, is not recorded.

mutants.name: gs6-examples-unweighted
mutants.rule: The fast tier's examples step, its longest, weighs the most of its steps.

mutants.name: gs16-cpu-record-path
mutants.rule: -record-durations -cpu runs a test binary with the toolchain first on PATH, as go test does.
mutants.gap: a record of cmd/ergo under an empty HOME; manual: -record-durations -cpu ./cmd/ergo exits 2 with the mutant

mutants.name: gatesandbox-sweep-store-per-step
mutants.rule: The closure sweep steps of a run share one std store, outside each step's TMPDIR.

mutants.name: gatesandbox-floor-unchecked

mutants.to: if reason := belowDiskFloor(floor*0, tmpDir, g.cacheDir); reason != "" {
mutants.rule: A step is not started below the disk floor: it fails naming the disk, not partway with ENOSPC.

mutants.name: gatesandbox-floor-compare
mutants.rule: Any free space below the floor refuses the step.

mutants.name: gatesandbox-floor-unreadable-passes
mutants.from: return fmt.Sprintf("disk floor: cannot read the free space under %s: %v", path, err)
mutants.rule: Free space that cannot be read refuses the step (fail closed).

mutants.name: mk0-step-blind-to-modules
mutants.rule: The examples step walks modules/ too, so an edit of a module reruns it (the fast tier's reach).

mutants.name: gate-seed-any-replace-local
mutants.rule: The merge tier verifies every downloaded module against go.sum: only a replace by a local directory exempts a require.
